Query: Query regarding management of leaf blight in arecanut.?
Answer: Ramove the heavily affected leaves from the plants and then apply  hexaconazole 10 ml/liter of water or copper oxychloride (blitox 50) 3 gram/liter of water 3 times at 15 days interval in the root portion of the plants by loosening of soil with help of hand hoe. after this apply the recommended doses of fertilizer  urea 200 gram, super 250 gram, potash 280 gram, borax 50 gram and dry cowdung 20 kg per plant in 2 equal split dose once in the month of march/april and other in the month september/october.

Query: Asking about soil health card?
Answer: Soil health card is a printed report that a farmer will be handed over for each of his holdings. it will contain the status of his soil with respect to 12 parameters, namely n,p,k (macro nutrients); s (secondary  nutrient); zn, fe, cu, mn, bo (micro   nutrients); and ph, ec, oc (physical parameters). based on this, the shc will also indicate fertilizer recommendations and soil amendment required for the farm.

[TYPE: expert_advice]
Query: Asking about nursery management of cauliflower?
Answer: Told him to select a sunny area with well drained friable light soil rich in organic matter. bring the soil into fine tilth and prepare the bed of 1 meter width and of convenient length. raise it to 10 15 cm above ground level. for an area of 10 meter square in the bed, mix 20 kg sand or silt and 20 kg compost. to make the soil free from soil borne disease causing pathogens drench the bed with formalin @ 40 ml/litre of water so as to saturate the soil upto a depth of 10 15 cm.keep in covered, immediately after treating, with polythene sheet or gunny bag paper for 2 days. uncover the soil and get it loosened and leave it as such for 3 4 days. treat the dry seeds with thiram @ 3g/kg seeds against seed borne pathogens. sow the seeds thinly in u shaped furrows spaced at 2.5 cm and at a depth of 1 2 cm.cover the seeds immediately with a thin layer of sand mixed with well dried and sieved cow dung. cover the seeds with a thin layer of straw. the seedlings get ready for transplanting when they attain 10 15 cm height or become 30 35 days old.
